تنتدبون (form VIII)
# تَنْتَدِبُونَ (tantadibūna) /tan.ta.di.buː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَدَبَ (intadaba)
# تُنْتَدَبُونَ (tuntadabūna) /tun.ta.da.buː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَدَبَ (intadaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
